title: Part Thirty-Seven: If It Were Enforced

sections.brief: The end state in the texts' words (Land pp.5-6: business owns a country, board hires and fires, residents customers, political interest 'semi-criminal proclivities', 'No voice, free exit', 'weak only in political freedom'; Yarvin 2012 'national CEO', 2025 'monarch is good', no removal mechanism; Patchwork confinement; no penal code, Land's hard money); the machinery as of Oct 2026 (records, travel, ecosystem map, money rails, Slaughter, EO 14410 ~8,000, NSPM-7, ICE 22,000, $45bn), built by both parties for other purposes; the gap (triggers, joins, consent: AAUP, DLA Piper, China comparator, court rulings both ways). Figures: flow, compare

Seven rungs, each: theorists' own words / what exists and for whom / worst-case extension. Watched (Fortify, unmasking subpoenas); fined (TOP, garnishment); prosecuted ('paper protections' as reported; 2025 'can't be' about bayoneting professors; NSPM-7, Bondi memo); removed (Patchwork emigration; 1,800 SEVIS; AAUP; 506 citizens held); confined (VR solitary; New Yorker summary; detention at record scale; CECOT torture and disappearance, forced labour not documented); compelled labour (no theorist prescribes it; Carlyle passage is hereditarian, not a programme; 13th Amendment exception, convict leasing, Bailey v. Alabama, 15-52 cents, 76% punished, $1/day 1950, Nwauzor conference 6 Nov 2026, Menocal 9-0; eight states removed the exception, Louisiana and California rejected). Figures: compare, time

The denied rung domain by domain: credit and debt (TOP, garnishment, 9.3m in default), banking (OFAC: ICC staff, Albanese own account, Leon injunction, re-listing 27 May, stay pending appeal 15 Jun 2026; debanking both ways: Choke Point, OCC findings, EO 14331), purchases (NICS 2024, SNAP waivers and Aragon v. Rollins, GENIUS 'seize, freeze, burn', Tether; Canada 257 accounts, SCC leave 22 Oct 2026), education (FAFSA conditions removed 2020, SEVIS, AAUP, Harvard), work and licences (E-Verify, 37 clearances, law-firm orders, NCSL 19 states 2018), travel and exit (passport debt rules, watchlist, Cleland; no exit permit; Russia, China), time off (no federal paid leave; FMLA), housing (13663, screening settlement), benefits (Medicaid 80 hours, SNAP to 64, Arkansas 18,000), digital (ICEBlock, Rosado); If it were connected (shared trigger graded possible; sanctions as the one shared trigger). Figures: one large compare

Thirteen rights (vote, removal, courts, speech, press, assembly, religion, due process, privacy, equal protection, movement and exit, petition, jury) against the Constitution's text and the texts' own words (Land pp.5-7, 10; NYT 2025 'free speech is a freedom. The right to vote is a form of power', 'pornographic stimulus', NYT a 'hereditary absolute monarchy'; New Yorker summary; Crimson 2021 universities line; Thiel 2009 and follow-up; Kent); silences stated (assembly, religion, privacy, jury); counter-reading (personal freedom) tested on Singapore's Freedom House scores. Figures: one large compare, stats

Texts: Patchwork 1 and 2 (confinement as the stated goal), Land p.18 ('sheer misfortune' then 'none of this is of the slightest importance'), Carlyle, Thiel 2009; today's sorting: public charge 1882-2026 (rescission effective 18 Sep 2026), 1996 welfare law, SNAP to 64, Medicaid 80 hours from 1 Jan 2027, Arkansas 18,000, Work Number; the line (what is lost, process, who is sorted; where it blurs); closes the part with The worst-case reading, tested (documented / probable / possible as a join / not supported; record against; both parties). Figures: compare, time
